lines.text: Which Pokémon do you prefer,\nthe Puppy Pokémon Growlithe or\r\nthe Scratch Cat Pokémon Meowth?
Which Pokémon do you prefer,\nthe Puppy Pokémon Growlithe or\r\nScratch Cat Pokémon Meowth?
Growlithe
Meowth
Ah! You didn’t have to answer. I knew the answer.\nSorry, it was a stupid question!
Oh! You didn’t have to answer. I knew it.\nSorry, it was a silly question!
If you catch [VAR NUM1(0000)] of the Puppy Pokémon Growlithe,\nI’ll give you a great Pokémon! You can ride on\r\nits back!
If you catch [VAR NUM1(0000)] of the Scratch Cat Pokémon\nMeowth, I’ll give you a pretty Pokémon! You can\r\nride on its back!
The Puppy Pokémon Growlithe can be found\non Route 6!\c\nCatch [VAR NUM1(0000)] Growlithe, and come back!
The Scratch Cat Pokémon Meowth appears to\nthe north of Cerulean City!\c\nCatch [VAR NUM1(0000)] Meowth, and come back!
Oh! You’ve caught [VAR NUM1(0000)] Puppy Pokémon!
Oh my! You’ve caught [VAR NUM1(0000)] Scratch Cat Pokémon!
As I promised, take this great Pokémon!
As I promised, take this pretty Pokémon!
When the cute Scratch Cat Pokémon Meowth\nevolves, it’ll look like this.
When the adorable Puppy Pokémon Growlithe\nevolves, it’ll look like this.
Hwooo! It’s as cute as ever!\nPersian is the best!
Awwwww! It’s as adorable as ever!\nArcanine is the best!
Hm? Why did I make you catch Puppy Pokémon\nand then give you a Scratch Cat Pokémon?
Huh? Why did I make you catch Scratch Cat\nPokémon and then give you a Puppy Pokémon?
Because I wanted to see if your preference\nwould stay the same...
Because I wanted to see if your preference\nwould stay the same...
even after seeing so many Growlithe...\nWahahaha!
even after seeing so many Meowth.\nTee-hee!
